CustomField.description: The title a home page case study card shows in place of the project Name, so the card can read as a story while the pillar pages keep the Name. Read by ProjectCardController.getHomeCaseStudies. Blank shows the Name.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The case study card's title on the home page, 120 characters at most. Leave blank to show the project Name.
CustomField.label: Home Title
